images.caption: Figure 2:The recursive loop carries critic weights through supervised transitions.Blue blocks distinguish actor-only RSR from joint actor–critic RPR; the bypass preserves the critic, and feedback returns the retained policy to the next cycle. The initial actor is RSR-1; Warm-up Critic Model denotes the prepared value network.

Figure 3:Rewriting and policy refinement update different parameters.The left branch discovers, rewrites, and verifies actor demonstrations; Recursive Policy-Refine (RPR) combines inherited values, reward calibration, and Turn-Boundary Skip-Observation GAE (TB-GAE). Phase-local critic calibration comprises four critic-only updates before joint training, not before each PPO minibatch.
